_comment: Representative fixture of the shared branch-protection policy for the example/tests. The real policy is maintained in metacraft-dev-guidelines/policies/branch-protection-policy.json and passed in by consumers. `role` and `requirePullRequest` are present on every class BECAUSE they are load-bearing: `requirePullRequest` decides whether a class is PR-only and `requirePullRequestReview` only sets the approval count, so a fixture that omits the former cannot exercise the distinction. `latest` is deliberately requirePullRequest=false with requireStatusChecks=true — the spec-mainline shape that must gate on CI without becoming PR-only.
